solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Indian love story about hospital with Charlie, not Romeo

indicators.note: with Charlie, not Romeo tells us to swap the Romeo letter for the Charlie letter
the love story wraps around the hospital letter, so about signals one piece going round another

parts.note: a love story is a romance
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone describes a romantic tale involving a hospital and a man named Charlie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts H inside ROMANCE to give ROMANCHE; 'not' then swaps its R (Romeo) for C (Charlie).
explanation.definitionFit: The Comanche are a Native American people of the southern Great Plains.

clue.text: Chest of heavy smoker, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says we want a word pronounced like the description

parts.note: a heavy smoker is often a cougher

explanation.surface: A remark about the chest of someone who smokes a lot.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface sends you to the lungs, but 'Chest' is a strongbox.
explanation.definitionFit: A coffer is a strongbox for valuables, a sense shared with the noun chest.

clue.text: Metronome-shaped primitive mammal

indicators.note: shaped tells us the letters of the word before it are formed into something new

explanation.surface: A mammal said to be built like a metronome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaped' rearranges METRONOME into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Monotremes, like the platypus and echidna, are egg-laying mammals considered primitive.

clue.text: Cable support leaks power — replace with new material

indicators.note: leaks says the cable support loses one of its letters
replace with says the lost letter gives way to another one

parts.note: a pylon holds up overhead power cables
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A warning that a pylon is losing electricity and needs replacing with a new material.
explanation.walkthrough: Take PYLON; 'leaks' drops P (power) and 'replace with' puts N (new) in its place.
explanation.definitionFit: Nylon is a synthetic fabric, a kind of material.

clue.text: Such robberies can get you stoned on the street

parts.note: stoned in slang means high on drugs
a way is a road or street, as in Broadway

explanation.surface: A warning that certain robberies might leave you intoxicated out in public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Such robberies' points to the phrase highway robbery; the surface hints at drugs on the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Highway robbery was the crime of holding up travellers on main roads.

clue.text: A "Keep Quiet!" sign in religious retreat

parts.note: sh is the hushing sound meaning keep quiet
the Ram, Aries, is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A notice demanding silence posted in a place of religious contemplation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sign' is a zodiac sign, Aries the Ram.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu hermitage or community for spiritual retreat.

clue.text: US student hopes room is free

indicators.note: is free says the letters are released to form a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An American student wishes their room were vacant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is free' rearranges HOPES ROOM.
explanation.definitionFit: In American schools and colleges a sophomore is a second-year student.

clue.text: A ruler raised to be Jamaican?

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a tsar was a Russian ruler

explanation.surface: Asks whether a ruler who was elevated came to be from Jamaica.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns A TSAR upside down in this down light. The question mark marks Jamaican as an example, not a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Rastafarianism began in Jamaica, so a Rasta is typically Jamaican.

clue.text: Road race could make sinners of the winners!

definitions.text: could make sinners of the winners!

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's first motorway, written MI in crosswords
a sprint is a short fast race

explanation.surface: A dark joke that a road race could turn its victors into wrongdoers.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a major British motorway, read as MI. A single wrong letter turns winners into sinners.
explanation.definitionFit: A typographical error changing one letter is what turns one word into the other.

clue.text: Fielders with mixed feelings

indicators.note: mixed tells us the letters of the following word are jumbled

explanation.surface: Cricket fielders with conflicting emotions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges FEELINGS. Fine leg is a fielding position behind the batsman on the leg side in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine legs are cricket fielders placed in the fine leg position.

clue.text: Fits in well with texting service

parts.note: a spa is a spring or mineral well
SMS is the short message service used for texting

explanation.surface: Something that suits nicely alongside a messaging service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fits' looks like a verb meaning suits; it is the noun for seizures.
explanation.definitionFit: Spasms are sudden convulsions, the same as fits in the medical sense.

clue.text: Iris or Jack

definitions.meaning: the yellow ... is a type of iris plant
a jack is a small ... flown on a ship

explanation.surface: Two names, a woman's and a man's.
explanation.definitionFit: A flag is both a wild iris and a banner, such as the Union Jack.

clue.text: Consumed by ecstasy, given a perfect score

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy
ten is a perfect score in judging, as in gymnastics

explanation.surface: Someone overwhelmed with joy after receiving top marks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Consumed by ecstasy' reads as one phrase, but 'Consumed' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something eaten has been consumed as food.

clue.text: Go broadcasting to feel wonderful

parts.note: to go on foot is to walk
a programme that is broadcasting is on air

explanation.surface: Advice to go on the radio to feel great.
explanation.definitionFit: To walk on air is an idiom for being elated.

clue.text: Will support a heartless clergy

parts.note: a leg supports a table or chair

indicators.note: heartless strips the clergy of all but its outside letters

explanation.surface: A testament backing a callous body of priests.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' keeps only C and Y of CLERGY.
explanation.definitionFit: A legacy is what someone leaves in a will, so the two stand for each other loosely.

clue.text: Bearded elf going topless? Now that's fanciful!

indicators.note: going topless means the bearded word loses its top letter in this down light

parts.note: bearded means hairy
an elf is a fairy

explanation.surface: A whimsical image of a bearded elf stripping off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going topless' takes the H off HAIRY; the elf stays as it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Airy-fairy means impractical and vague, much like fanciful.

clue.text: Healthy island for a jazz player

parts.note: good can mean healthy, as in good for you
the Isle of Man lies in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A fit islander who plays jazz.
explanation.walkthrough: Benny Goodman was the American 'King of Swing' clarinettist.
explanation.definitionFit: Benny Goodman was a famous jazz clarinettist and bandleader.

clue.text: Religious teacher of Amish with hair specially styled

indicators.note: specially styled, as by a hairdresser, says the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spiritual guru from the Amish with a special hairdo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'specially styled' rearranges AMISH HAIR.
explanation.definitionFit: A maharishi is a Hindu sage or spiritual guide.

clue.text: He can sing (apart from one false note)

parts.note: bar means except or apart from
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: false says the word note is not in its true order

explanation.surface: A singer who is fine except for one wrong note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false' rearranges NOTE into TONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer with a voice between tenor and bass.

clue.text: A small number slipped up, as stated

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a small number
erred means made a mistake or slipped up

explanation.surface: A few people made mistakes, as reported.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small number' is a Roman numeral, V for five.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to declare firmly, so averred means stated.

clue.text: Italian leader about to be excluded from contract

indicators.note: to be excluded from says one word is taken out of another

parts.note: to contract is to reduce
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An Italian boss is about to be cut out of a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' is the verb meaning shrink, not a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Il Duce was the title Mussolini took as Italy's fascist leader.

clue.text: Odd bits of currency he found in the nursery

indicators.note: odd bits of picks the first, third, fifth and seventh letters

explanation.surface: A man finds loose change in a children's nursery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd bits of' takes C, R, E, C from currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A crèche is a day nursery for young children.

clue.text: Puncture in wrecked car could kill you

indicators.note: in places the puncture inside the scrambled car
wrecked says the letters of car are smashed into a new order

parts.note: a puncture is a hole

explanation.surface: A flat tyre in a crashed car might be fatal.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a road accident; 'could kill you' is the definition, a description of a deadly disease rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Cholera is an often fatal bacterial disease, so it is something that may kill.

clue.text: Maureen uses revolutionary hair product

parts.note: Mo is a short form of the name Maureen

indicators.note: revolutionary says the letters of uses are turned over into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman called Maureen uses a radical styling product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' rearranges USES into USSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Mousse is a foam used to style hair.

clue.text: By that very deed, coming from the lips of actors

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A Latin phrase heard spoken by performers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin tag means by the fact itself, the same as by that very deed.

clue.text: Grass is an advantage after summer starts

indicators.note: after puts the advantage behind the first letter
starts picks the opening letter of summer

parts.note: an edge is an advantage

explanation.surface: Lawn grass gets ahead once summer begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grass' looks like a lawn but is the marsh plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grasslike plant growing in wet ground.

clue.text: Tailless fish still has source of power

indicators.note: tailless removes the last letter of the fish

parts.note: the turbot is a flatfish

explanation.surface: A fish without its tail still has a means of propulsion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tailless' drops the final T of TURBOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A turbo, short for turbocharger, boosts an engine's power.

clue.text: Rubbish turns up like this in a trunk

indicators.note: in a down light turns up means read upward, so backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish
so means in this way, like this

explanation.surface: Garbage appears in this state inside a luggage trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' suggests luggage or a tree; it is the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the trunk of the human body, without head and limbs.

clue.text: Admit to being a priest

parts.note: reads as a confession, but means formally admitting someone into the priesthood

explanation.surface: A clergyman confesses his vocation.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to confer holy orders, admitting someone into the priesthood.

clue.text: Wicked sin hoarding money — could be an obsession

indicators.note: hoarding says one piece keeps another stored inside it
wicked says the letters of sin are twisted into another order

parts.note: euros are money in much of Europe

explanation.surface: Stockpiling cash as a sinful habit may be compulsive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wicked' looks like a description of the sin but signals the rearrangement; 'could be' marks the obsession as one example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An obsession is one kind of neurosis, a mental disorder of anxiety.

clue.text: Boy's (or girl's!) flat, extremely lovely interior

definitions.note: a boy's name, though it is also used for girls; the 's stands for is

indicators.note: interior says the extreme letters go inside the flat

parts.note: flat means level or even

indicators.note: extremely picks the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A child's apartment, with a very charming inside.
explanation.walkthrough: '(or girl's!)' notes that the name is used for both sexes: the novelist Evelyn Waugh was a man.
explanation.definitionFit: The forename is given to both sexes, as with the writer Evelyn Waugh.

clue.text: Driving force from which Americans take the lead

definitions.text: Driving force from which Americans take the lead

parts.words: Driving force from which Americans take the lead
parts.note: the fuel that powers American cars, from which lead was removed in the move to unleaded

explanation.surface: A motivating force that the US follows.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the US word for petrol, now sold unleaded after lead was taken out.
